text_block_list.text:
One day, as the end of the school year 
drew near, some wonderful news arrived. 
You see—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
As the representative of the selection 
committee, it is my humble honor to 
present this award!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
<chrname>-san, congratulations on being selected as 
the Best Senior Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Your performance this year was absolutely 
magnificent! I believe the races both of 
you ran gave countless people dreams to 
believe in!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"And so today, we have guests who know the 
two of them very well—"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Joining us today from the Japan Umamusume 
Training Center Academy are Chairwoman 
Akikawa and Secretary Hayakawa!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to intrude on you like this. 
Congratulations to you both.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
As someone involved in the Umamusume 
world, this is completely agreeable, 
wonderful news!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Watching the two of you join hands and 
climb to greater heights has moved the 
hearts of so many people.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm! There is no doubt that you all will 
lead the Umamusume world into the future!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I wholeheartedly wish for your continued 
success! Once more... splendid work!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I will continue to support you from behind 
the scenes.

The press conference ended amidst immense 
excitement— and together with <chrname>, we vowed 
to achieve even greater success moving 
forward!
